name: zhiyun
description: Practical Intelligent Web Data Extraction Platform

scripts.test:platform: vitest run packages/platform-core capabilities/storage-sqlite capabilities/storage-postgres capabilities/queue-local capabilities/queue-redis capabilities/artifact-store
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose up -d && bun run db:migrate && playwright test -c apps/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:smoke:desktop-package: bun run desktop:package && bun run --filter @zhiyun/desktop test:packaged
scripts.worker:lint: cd services/analytics-worker && uv run ruff check src tests scripts packaging
scripts.worker:format: cd services/analytics-worker && uv run ruff format src tests scripts packaging
scripts.worker:openapi:generate: cd services/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py
scripts.worker:openapi:check: cd services/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py --check
scripts.worker:client:check: bun run worker:openapi:check && bun run --filter @zhiyun/analytics-worker-client check:generated
scripts.worker:build: cd services/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/build.py
scripts.worker:smoke: cd services/analytics-worker && uv run python scripts/smoke.py
scripts.architecture:deps: depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs packages plugins capabilities profiles apps --output-type err
scripts.release:verify: bun run lint && bun run worker:lint && bun run format:check && bun run client:check && bun run worker:client:check && bun run typecheck && bun run worker:test && bun run test && bun run build && bun run test:e2e:web && bun run test:e2e:desktop && bun run test:smoke:desktop-package
